results.title: MLB utility player retires after 8 seasons: ‘Not bad for an undersized kid’
results.description: Veteran utility infielder/outfielder Jon Berti has retired from MLB after eight seasons.

results.title: Two of 2026's biggest AAA action games get their first-ever discounts on the PlayStation Store
results.description: Deal | Sony's PlayStation Store newest sales event has brought significant discounts to thousands of games on the platform. Two of this year's most high-profile games benefit, with both Crimson Desert and IO Interactive's 007 First Light getting temporary price slashes for the first time on PlayStation.
